$comment: Review-flag register for the Chhelebela Score memory bank. POLICY (per data instructions): questionable entries are flagged for human review — nothing uncertain was silently corrected, reclassified, or deleted. Every flag id referenced in memories.json#items[].flags resolves here. Severity: blocker = must be resolved before launch; warning = should be resolved before launch or consciously accepted; info = editorial note / verify when convenient. The content owner triages flags; resolution is recorded by changing flag status (vocabulary.json#flag_status).

flags.title: No item is publish-ready: all 30 rows are 'Under review' and last_reviewed is missing everywhere
flags.detail: SRS 6.8 requires every published item to carry a review status and last-reviewed date, and only verified items may ship. The spreadsheet marks every row 'Under review' with no review dates.
flags.recommended_action: Run the content review pass (multiple age groups and regions per SRS 6.8), set validation_status to verified/retired per item, and fill last_reviewed.

flags.title: era_classification_eligible is false for all 30 items, making era affinity (FR-010, Must) uncomputable
flags.detail: SRS FR-010 requires an era profile, and §6.3 defines era affinity from experienced items with clear era association. With every item ineligible, the MVP cannot meet FR-010. This is likely a holdover from the pre-verification state of the sheet, but it must be an explicit decision, not a default.
flags.recommended_action: After era verification (see item flags), decide per item whether it enters era-affinity calculations; resolve SRS OD-05 (multi-era handling: exclude vs fractional allocation) at the same time.

flags.title: Reference ids R1–R23 are cited but never defined (dangling references)
flags.detail: The spreadsheet's evidence column cites R1–R23, but the workbook contains no reference sheet. The idea proposal supplies only nine URLs. references.json registers all 23 ids with publisher hints and unconfirmed candidate URLs; zero are confirmed.
flags.recommended_action: Content team locates and records each actual source (URL + access date). Do not treat candidate_pool_id matches as citations until confirmed.

flags.title: Category vocabulary mismatch between spreadsheet and SRS/proposal channels
flags.detail: Spreadsheet FAMILY and PLAY do not exist in the SRS FR-003 channel list; the SRS 'cricket moments' channel has zero items; Eid-related memory (MEM_006) sits in FAMILY while the proposal groups Eid under 'music and Eid'. Mapping applied: TV→tv, BOOKS→books, PLAY→games, FOOD→food, MUSIC→music_eid, SCHOOL→school, TECH→tech_gaming, FAMILY→family_community (extension).
flags.recommended_action: Product owner finalizes the controlled category list (OD-04): keep or drop family_community, decide where Eid cards belong, and confirm cricket_moments stays in scope for MVP.

flags.title: Dataset has 30 items vs 100–120 promised in the proposal (SRS OD-13 tests 60–80)
flags.detail: The proposal commits to 100–120 items; the SRS asks whether 60–80 is sufficient. At 30 items the quiz will be short and era/category coverage thin (cricket: 0, food: 2, books: 2).
flags.recommended_action: Content expansion sprint. New items must follow the same pipeline: sourced evidence, era+setting tags, flags for anything uncertain. Do not auto-generate items to hit the count.

flags.title: 14 of 30 items have setting 'unknown', which is not an SRS-approved setting value
flags.detail: SRS 6.6 approves urban/rural/both/context-specific. 'unknown' was carried over as an explicit research debt. Items: MEM_002, 003, 004, 005, 014, 015, 016, 019, 020, 021, 024, 025, 026, 030.
flags.recommended_action: Research each item's likely context before launch and replace 'unknown' with an evidence-based tag; extend vocabulary only via OD-04.

flags.title: Spreadsheet era vocabulary normalized ('00s'→'2000s'; era_role split into era_scope + classification_confidence)
flags.detail: The single era_role column conflated two ideas: whether an item spans eras (now era_scope) and how confident the classification is (now classification_confidence). legacy_mappings in vocabulary.json documents the full mapping. Also note 13 of 30 items carry urban-only setting tags vs 2 rural-only — see FLG-DS-11.
flags.recommended_action: Data steward signs off on the normalization (or amends it) before the app treats these fields as final.

flags.title: origin_period is evidence-backed on only 5 of 30 items
flags.detail: SRS 6.5 requires distinguishing origin period from Bangladeshi popularity period. Only MEM_001 (1993), MEM_019 (1985), MEM_020 (1988–89), MEM_021 (2005), MEM_026 (2004) have evidence-supported origins. The other 25 are null rather than guessed. popularity_period_bd is present for all 30 (carried from the spreadsheet's supported_period).
flags.recommended_action: Research origin dates per item (OD-03). Remember SRS 6.5: do not label by international release when Bangladeshi popularity came later (MEM_022's treatment is the model).

flags.recommended_action: Either source and add the era-neutral cricket items (with references) or record that cricket_moments is deferred post-MVP.

flags.title: Source concentration and Dhaka/English-media bias (SRS §12 risk realized)
flags.detail: R2 alone backs 5 items; R6 backs 3; R21 (a single Dhaka memoir) backs 3; 13 of 30 items are urban-tagged vs 2 rural. Sources are predominantly Dhaka-centric English press and personal memoirs — exactly the urban/middle-class overrepresentation the SRS flags as a risk.
flags.recommended_action: Diversify sources: Bangla-language press and district/village respondents (the proposal's own recommended short Bangla poll), per SRS 6.8 multi-background review.
